concept: Aurora Replicas: reader endpoint for read scaling
tests: How to offload reporting from the Aurora writer and scale reads easily.
expected: Add Aurora Replicas (shared cluster storage) and point reports at the reader endpoint. Triggers: "reporting workload overwhelms the primary", "offload reads", "scale read capacity".
why_not: A bigger primary doesn't isolate reads from writes; a separate Single-AZ RDS isn't tied to the cluster; NAT Gateway is network egress.
